title: 第一卷 第9章 剑法比试大获全胜第一卷 第10章 再次比试一剑秒杀
lines: 姜牧野别看只有六岁，修为境界却不低，已达到凡位四重境。
这就是七品灵根的厉害之处，修为进阶速度，远远将同龄人甩在身后。
“若叶无尘真是天生剑灵体，可敢与我比试一番？”
稚嫩的声音，略带凶狠之意，回响在西院后山的天空。
人们全都一阵愣神，用奇异的目光看向姜牧野。
谁能想到，一个六岁的儿童，竟如此有胜负欲。
“看来是叶无尘身上的那三件至宝，刺激到了姜牧野！”
“谁说不是呢，叶家真是把叶无尘给宠坏了，离火月金镯，碧海斑斓带，乾坤坠，这三样宝贝，按理来说应该是戴在姜牧野的身上才对。”
人们议论纷纷，一个是侯府的麒麟孙，一个是叶家宠上天的平庸之子。
二者之间明显有着巨大的反差对比。
不过，如果叶无尘真的拥有“先天剑灵体”，那情况又不一样了。
将会严重威胁到姜牧野在侯府的地位。
也就难怪姜牧野对叶无尘的敌意如此之大了。
叶蓉凤皱眉道：“姜牧野的修为已经达到凡位四重，而我们尘儿还未曾进行修炼，二者之间进行剑法比试，恐怕不合适吧？”
叶剑明也是一个护犊子的，当即拒绝道：“说得没错，尘儿毫无修为，没必要接受一场不公平的比试。”
“咯咯……既然不敢接受比试，你们就不该招摇过市，哗众取宠，说什么叶无尘是先天剑灵体，这种拙劣的小把戏，当真上不得台面！”
周丽婷轻蔑一笑，在她看来，叶琉璃明显就是不服气，这才急着给叶无尘安上一个天才的名头。
毕竟她的孩子可是天生七品灵根，光芒太耀眼了，难免让人生出嫉妒攀比之意。
叶蓉凤是个火爆的脾气，当即指着周丽婷的鼻子大骂道：“恶妇，你嘴巴最好放干净点，否则小心我撕烂你的嘴！”
“呵呵，这技不如人，便开始言语威胁了？”
周丽婷满脸得意，不断阴阳怪气道：“我家牧儿可以不施展灵力，单凭用剑法便能彻底碾压叶无尘，现在你们可还有理由拒绝挑战？”
老夫人也点点头道：“压制灵力，就仅仅单纯的剑法比试，我看没什么问题！”
一时间，叶家人都为之犯难。
须知叶无尘年仅三岁，还是第一次练剑，而姜牧野已经练习剑法足有三年，还是名师教导。
双方之间单单以剑法比试，叶无尘也毫无胜算可言。
就在叶家人思考着用如何理由拒绝时，叶无尘却神情坚定的站出道：“好，我接受姜牧野的挑战！”
“尘儿！”
叶琉璃一时心疼，她看得出来，叶无尘从小就早慧，此次强行出头，其实就是为了挽回叶家的面子。
叶无尘奶声奶气道：“娘，您就放心好了，我一定不会给叶家丢人的！”
“好，小小年纪，已有不惧输赢的心性，品性不错，是个修炼的好苗子！”
“是啊，心性坚毅，乃修行一道最重要的品格之一，只可惜天赋弱了，仅仅三品灵根，成就上限太低。”
一众姜家长老眼中都流露出赞赏之意，同时也不禁扼腕叹息，如果叶无尘的灵根达到四品，未必没有机会培养成才。
但三品灵根的话，这一辈子恐怕都难以抵达三境领域。
修行四境，分别为凡位境，聚灵境，筑法境，凝道境，每个大境界又分别为九个小境界。
三境领域，则指筑法境修为！
“比试开始！”
content_en:
Although Jiang Muye is only six years old, his cultivation level is not low and he has reached the fourth level of mortal realm.
This is the power of seventh-grade spiritual roots. The speed of cultivation advancement is far behind those of the same age.
"If Ye Wuchen is really born with a sword spirit, can he dare to compete with me?"
The childish voice, with a hint of ferocity, echoed in the sky behind the west courtyard.
Everyone was stunned for a moment, looking at Jiang Muye with strange eyes.
Who would have thought that a six-year-old child would be so eager to win.
"It seems that the three treasures on Ye Wuchen's body have stimulated Jiang Muye!"
"Who says otherwise? The Ye family has really spoiled Ye Wuchen. The Lihuoyue Golden Bracelet, the Blue Sea Colorful Belt, and the Qiankun Pendant. Logically speaking, these three treasures should be worn on Jiang Muye."
People were talking a lot, one was the Qilin grandson of the Hou family, and the other was the mediocre son of the Ye family who was favored by heaven.
There is obviously a huge contrast between the two.
However, if Ye Wuchen really has an "innate sword spirit body", then the situation will be different.
It will seriously threaten Jiang Muye's position in the Hou Mansion.
No wonder Jiang Muye was so hostile to Ye Wuchen.
Ye Rongfeng frowned and said, "Jiang Muye's cultivation has reached the fourth level of the mortal realm, but we, Chen'er, have not yet practiced. I'm afraid it would be inappropriate to have a swordsmanship competition between the two, right?"
Ye Jianming was also a protector and immediately refused: "That's right. Chen'er has no cultivation. There is no need to accept an unfair competition."
"Giggle... Since you don't dare to accept the competition, you shouldn't show off and try to flatter others by saying that Ye Wuchen is an innate sword spirit. Such clumsy little tricks are really not worthy of the stage!"
Zhou Liting smiled contemptuously. In her opinion, Ye Liuli was obviously unconvinced, so she was eager to give Ye Wuchen the title of genius.
After all, her child was born with a seventh-grade spiritual root, and the light was so dazzling that it would inevitably make people jealous and compare.
Ye Rongfeng had a hot temper and immediately pointed at Zhou Liting's nose and cursed: "Evil woman, you'd better keep your mouth clean, otherwise I'll tear your mouth apart!"
"Haha, your skills are inferior to others, so you start to threaten with words?"
Zhou Liting's face was full of pride, and she kept saying in a strange tone: "My Mu'er can completely crush Ye Wuchen with just sword skills without using any spiritual power. Now do you still have a reason to refuse the challenge?"
The old lady also nodded and said: "Suppressing spiritual power is just a simple swordsmanship competition. I don't think there is any problem!"
"This..."
For a time, the Ye family was in trouble.
It should be noted that Ye Wuchen was only three years old and was practicing swordsmanship for the first time, while Jiang Muye had been practicing swordsmanship for three years and was taught by a famous teacher.
In a swordsmanship competition between the two sides, Ye Wuchen had no chance of winning.
Just when the Ye family was thinking about how to refuse, Ye Wuchen stood up firmly and said: "Okay, I accept Jiang Muye's challenge!"
"Chen'er!"
Ye Liuli felt distressed for a moment. She could see that Ye Wuchen had been smart since he was a child, and the reason he forced himself to come forward this time was actually to save the Ye family's face.
Ye Wuchen said with a sweet voice: "Mom, don't worry, I will definitely not embarrass the Ye family!"
"Okay, at such a young age, I already have a mind that is not afraid of winning or losing. I have a good character and I am a good candidate for cultivation!"
"Yes, perseverance is one of the most important qualities in cultivating a religion. It's a pity that the talent is weak. With only a third-grade spiritual root, the upper limit of achievement is too low."
All the elders of the Jiang family showed admiration in their eyes, and at the same time they couldn't help sighing. If Ye Wuchen's spiritual roots reached the fourth level, he might not have the chance to cultivate talents.
But if you have a third-grade spiritual root, it may be difficult to reach the three realms in this life.
The four realms of practice are the mortal realm, the spiritual gathering realm, the Dharma-building realm, and the Tao-condensing realm. Each major realm is divided into nine small realms.
The three realms refer to the cultivation of Dharma Realm!
"The competition begins!"
title_en: Volume 1, Chapter 9: A great victory in the swordsmanship competition. Volume 1: Chapter 10: Another fight to kill instantly with one sword.
